description: The delivery status of a message send_imessage sent (Sendblue: QUEUED, SENT, DELIVERED or ERROR, and whether it went as iMessage or fell back to SMS; LoopMessage: processing, delivered, failed or unknown), with the provider's own error words. name: get_imessage_status
